meta.title: Allan “Cielesis” Cote · Web & Game Developer Portfolio
meta.description: Portfolio of Allan “Cielesis” Cote, web developer, designer and game developer from Le Havre, France. Creator of Void Nebula. Open to work and collaborations.

profile.title: Profile
profile.bio: I’m a developer and designer specialized in web and video games, i love doing creative things for the internet. Open to work and collaborations.

folderDescs.folder-games: The games I made, from a full Steam release to gamejam entries, plus my mods.
folderDescs.folder-socials: Where to find me and follow what I'm working on.
folderDescs.folder-websites: Websites and web apps I designed and built.
folderDescs.folder-videos: Trailers, devlogs and other videos I edited.
folderDescs.folder-webcomics: Comics I wrote and drew, to read online.
folderDescs.folder-pro: Work I did for clients and organisations.

icon-VN.label: Void Nebula
icon-VN.desc: One my biggest project, this is a video-game made from scratch, with over 2000 hours of work. This game is a sci-fi roguelike deckbuilding game with card customisation elements.

icon-TAKES.label: Explosive Knight TAKES Flying Pawn
icon-TAKES.desc: A 1v1 chess game with more than 40 pieces with weird and unique effects, made in two weeks for a gamejam.

icon-babelfest.label: Babelfest
icon-babelfest.desc: Babelfest was a card game made in JavaScript, designed to be a massive collaboration including any artists that wanted to be a part of it.

icon-lofi-cafe.label: Cielesis's Lofi Cafe
icon-lofi-cafe.desc: This small app is a radio directly connected to multiple live feeds on YouTube, to listen to Lofi, Jazz and other chill songs.

icon-mission-locale.label: Mission Locale
icon-mission-locale.desc: While I was working at the Mission Locale, I had the opportunity to lead a complete visual rebranding.

icon-webcomic-alternative.label: Alternative
icon-webcomic-alternative.desc: This webcomic is a science fantasy story written and drawn entirely by me. The first volume is available in print.
